from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyProfitData(BaseModel):
    """Financial profit/loss information extracted from a single company's report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company filing the report")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., 'three months ended March 31, 2024')")
    line_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label describing the figure (e.g., 'Net Loss', 'Net Income')")
    net_result: float | None = Field(description="The profit or loss amount; a loss should be represented as a negative number")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions')")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the profit/loss figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_profit_data: list[CompanyProfitData]
